meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu - International Company (VU_IC) regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended; Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 293] (FTRA) as amended; International Service Providers Act [Cap 305] (ISPA); Companies and Charitable Institutions (Beneficial Ownership Transparency) Act 2020-2021; VFSC and Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) AML/CFT directives, regulations, and supervisory guidance issued under the FTRA and ISPA.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or other competent authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; chain authentication through the competent authority of the origin country and legalization by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and External Trade or an accredited Vanuatu consular post)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address issued within the last 3 months (utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not domestically recognized; chain authentication and consular legalization required)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banking reference letter covering account conduct, source of funds and good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank licensed in its home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not domestically recognized; signature and capacity of the issuing bank to be verified through the legalization chain)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter issued by a licensed attorney or certified accountant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Law firm or accounting firm providing the professional reference
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not domestically recognized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or current registry extract for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or other competent authority of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not domestically recognized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized source of wealth and source of funds declaration with supporting documentary evidence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not domestically recognized)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-onboarding and ongoing screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, the United Nations Consolidated List, the EU and UK HM Treasury consolidated sanctions lists, INTERPOL notices, and the watchlists and alerts issued by the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and the VFSC; Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), family members and known close associates must be identified at onboarding, subjected to Enhanced Due Diligence, and require senior management approval before acceptance; transaction monitoring, adverse-media screening and trigger-based re-screening must be performed at least annually and upon any material change in ownership or control.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry online search facility (vfsc.vu); name reservation is effected by a VFSC-licensed International Service Provider or registered agent on behalf of the incorporator
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: An International Company name must be expressed in Latin/Roman script; English, French and Bislama romanized forms are accepted; a name originally in non-Latin script must be transliterated with a certified transliteration; the name must contain a restricted corporate suffix such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Societe Anonyme or a standard abbreviation thereof; the name must not be identical or so closely resemble any name already registered, reserved or in use in Vanuatu.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: any word implying a connection with the Government of Vanuatu or a foreign government
any word requiring prior ministerial approval or a licence from the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection the registered agent shall (1) file a fresh name reservation containing permissible and distinguishable tokens; (2) submit a written reconsideration request to the VFSC Registry Manager within 14 days of the rejection date; (3) if the refusal is maintained, lodge a formal administrative appeal to the VFSC; and (4) if still unsuccessful, institute a statutory application to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 21 days of the final written refusal, in accordance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Companies Act processes applicable to name clearance decisions.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physical registered office in Vanuatu is mandatory for every International Company; a standalone virtual office, PO Box or mail-forwarding address without the backing of a VFSC-licensed International Service Provider is not recognized as satisfying the statutory requirement. The licensed registered agent's physical Vanuatu office may serve as the statutory registered office, and virtual-office conveniences such as mail forwarding and director/convenience meeting addresses are permissible ancillary services only where the statutory physical address remains continuously effective.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 3-5% annualized likelihood for a passive, low-risk stock-media holding International Company with no regulated financial activity; the likelihood rises to approximately 20-30% if the company later engages in regulated financial services, becomes subject to a foreign financial intelligence request, or is flagged by the VFIU or VFSC.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 33 of 1992 (Cap. 222), as amended; ss. 6-14 (incorporation), s. 35 (registered office and registered agent), s. 37 (directors and secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Section, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association, together with the Registration Statement submitted to the VFSC Registrar of International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required. Authorized share capital may be denominated in Vatu or any foreign currency. No statutory escrow or capital deposit account is required for an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers taking shares under the registration statement hereby accept the allocated shares and agree to pay share consideration as recorded in the register of members. RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company in Vanuatu, as maintained by the licensed registered agent, is approved and adopted as the Company's statutory address and principal place of registered administration. RESOLVED that the individuals named in the schedule are appointed as Directors and the Secretary of the Company, with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and instruct professional advisers. RESOLVED that the directors' first meeting is deemed validly held and all formation expenses are ratified. RESOLVED that the Chairman and Secretary are authorized to file this resolution with VFSC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The licensed registered agent submits two proposed company names to the VFSC for availability screening against the existing register. The preferred name is reserved for a statutory period pending formal registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is refused as identical or confusingly similar, file the alternative name or request reconsideration with evidence of distinctiveness.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed VFSC registered agent and corporate services provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association setting out authorized capital, share classes, director provisions, subscriber details, and the registered agent clause. All drafts are circulated to subscribers for initialling.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any constitutional provision, amend the relevant clause by subscriber consent and resubmit the corrected document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and authorized witness/notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Subscribers execute the subscription pages and appoint the first directors and secretary. Each director and secretary signs a consent to act, which is witnessed in accordance with VFSC requirements.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If signatures or witness attestations are imperfect, obtain re-execution and resubmit the corrected consent forms.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent files the statutory registration statement and the constitutional documents electronically or in hard copy at the VFSC, together with the prescribed government filing fee.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a requisition or objection, respond with a corrective submission within 14 calendar days identifying the matter and providing the required evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the applicable government incorporation fee and first-year annual registration fee from the client funds account via wire or direct deposit. Obtain an official receipt and attach it to the filing record.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the payment receipt differs from the assessment, apply to VFSC Finance for immediate reconciliation before certificate issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review and fee payment, the VFSC registers the company, assigns a company number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The legal person and separate entity status commence on the certificate date.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains inaccurate particulars, apply to the Registrar for administrative rectification or issuance of a replacement certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening of First Board Meeting and Pro-Forma Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial board of directors and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or circulate a written resolution to adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption, and officer appointments. Minute the resolution and place it on the statutory records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the resolution is incomplete, convene a supplementary board meeting and file the curative resolution with VFSC records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office Confirmation and Initial Statutory Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by the registered agent, establish statutory registers, prepare share certificates, and notify the board of annual renewal obligations.
required_dossiers: Statutory register of members and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office details change or were recorded incorrectly, file the prescribed notice of change with VFSC without delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable; no industrial licensing authority is triggered for an offshore digital stock-media and generative visual assets company. Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) only advises on sector incentives and does not issue an operating permit for this activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating license is required for a stock photography marketplace or AI visual-content platform under current Vanuatu law; the Certificate of Incorporation and compliance with the International Companies Act suffice for offshore operations.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category III administrative registration is not triggered because the undertaking is a digital service with no physical industrial plant, development footprint, or land-disturbing activity. A full or preliminary EIA would only be required for any future physical data-center or office construction.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or combustion emissions arise from the licensed digital activity. If a physical office is later established, it must comply with the Water Resources Act and Waste Management Regulations; zero industrial discharge threshold applies to remote operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not required for incorporation without physical premises. If a physical office or studio is subsequently opened, the company must obtain a fire safety certificate under Port Vila Municipal Council by-laws, a structural load clearance for the premises, and an Occupational Health and Safety workplace registration before occupancy.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue; online portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities are not subject to a general income tax registration requirement in Vanuatu. The Vanuatu International Companies Act (Cap. 222) requires an International Company (IC) to file its registered office and agent details with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). For VAT purposes, only a business making taxable supplies above the VAT registration threshold must apply to the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue for a VAT identification number. A foreign entity with no Vanuatu source income and no local fixed establishment has no statutory TIN obligation; a Tax Identification Number is issued only upon VAT registration or employer PAYE registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu generally imposes no income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, or estate duty on International Companies. There is no check-the-box election because Vanuatu does not levy corporate income tax. An IC may elect to register for VAT voluntarily once it meets the turnover threshold, but no hybrid mismatch elections are available in domestic law. Under the International Companies Act, an IC may not elect for taxation as a resident company; the statutory tax exemption is automatic and non-elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 (four million vatu) annual taxable turnover; voluntary registration permitted below this threshold; exporters of goods and certain services may register to claim zero-rating and input VAT recovery.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently operate a mandatory electronic invoicing clearance (e-invoicing) regime with real-time fiscal APIs or digital stamping. VAT-registered persons must issue a tax invoice containing prescribed particulars (seller name and VAT registration number, invoice number, date, description, consideration excluding VAT, VAT amount, and total). Records must be maintained in Vanuatu or be accessible electronically; no real-time government clearance or pre-approval of invoices is required. The Department of Customs and Inland Revenue may require periodic electronic lodgment of VAT returns, but there is no central e-invoicing database.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under the Value Added Tax Act 2013 (Cap. 231) to: (a) the export of goods from Vanuatu, provided the exporter retains proof of physical export; (b) international transport of passengers or goods; (c) supplies of certain offshore services to non-residents, including the supply of digital goods, royalty-like payments for the use of intellectual property, and services physically performed outside Vanuatu; and (d) supplies to a person carrying on business outside Vanuatu where the services are directly related to goods outside Vanuatu or are for direct use outside Vanuatu. A stock photography and generative visual assets platform selling digital image licenses to non-resident customers is generally eligible for zero-rating as an export of services, provided the supplier is a VAT-registered person and holds contemporaneous documentary evidence of the recipient's non-resident status and the offshore performance or consumption of the service.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (from Vanuatu Customs Service) for physical export of goods
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (delivery proof for physical goods)
Inward Remittance Certificate (foreign exchange receipt evidence from a Vanuatu licensed bank)
VAT Export Invoice with VAT registration number of supplier
Contract or license agreement evidencing the non-resident customer and offshore usage of digital assets
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported zero-rating claims are subject to reassessment by the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, which may claw back the unrecovered VAT together with interest. Penalties under the Value Added Tax Act include an initial penalty of up to 200% of the tax shortfall for intentional evasion or fraud, plus late payment penalties of 2% per month or part-month. Criminal prosecution is possible for knowingly furnishing false documentation, with fines and imprisonment. The Department has the power to require contemporaneous bank records and export documentation; failure to produce the mandated bundle within the statutory audit window results in automatic denial of the zero-rating claim and retrospective VAT assessment at 15%.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal foreign exchange regime with no statutory exchange controls on current account or capital account transactions applicable to Vanuatu International Companies. The Vanuatu vatu is convertible through Reserve Bank of Vanuatu authorized dealers into USD, AUD, NZD, EUR, JPY, and other major currencies, though offshore VUV liquidity is narrow and treasury settlement for cross-border stock-media licensing is normally denominated in USD. Profits, dividends, royalties, and capital repatriation from an International Company are not subject to Vanuatu exchange-control approval, withholding tax, or a profit remittance quota; however, the paying bank and receiving correspondent bank will still apply anti-money laundering source-of-funds and sanctions screening before release.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export-proceeds surrender rules, mandated conversion ratios, or repatriation deadlines in Vanuatu. An International Company may lawfully retain gross licensing and stock-photo export receipts in any permissible foreign currency ledger, including USD, in a domestic commercial bank or authorized dealer. The Reserve Bank of Vanuatu does not compel conversion into VUV and does not require a conversion permit for receipts attributable to an International Company operating outside the Vanuatu domestic economy.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium feasibility with material legal constraints. A Vanuatu International Company may use a licensed foreign fintech EMI or digital cross-border payment platform for outbound licensing, disbursement, or wallet collection, but such an EMI cannot operate as a deposit-taking institution inside Vanuatu without a Reserve Bank of Vanuatu license. Offshore EMIs are most viable for USD or EUR treasury concentration outside Vanuatu, while the primary corporate bank account should remain at a Vanuatu authorized dealer to facilitate proof of funds, CRS/AEOI reporting status, and correspondent banking clearance. VUV-denominated wallet balances must not be held through an unregulated offshore EMI because VUV settlement remains subject to RBV-supervised banking channels.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: There is no statutory obligation that all directors appear physically in Vanuatu for corporate bank onboarding. Risk-based AML/CFT rules allow licensed banks to complete remote account opening using certified passports, independent electronic identity verification, live video interviews, and notarized corporate resolutions. In practice, a full remote pathway is available for low-risk non-resident International Companies in the stock-photo licensing industry, but some banks retain the discretion to require an in-country meeting or a physical director interview for complex ownership structures, high projected transaction volumes, or insufficient source-of-wealth documentation. The local registered agent and Vanuatu company secretary should coordinate the onboarding files to reduce friction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity arising from International Company status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified extract from the Vanuatu International Companies Registry; register of members; beneficial ownership declaration; signed ownership chart; certified passport copies and residential proof for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner; written consent from the registered agent confirming statutory records are held in Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-haven or low-tax jurisdiction perception in correspondent banking
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Good Standing certificate issued by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; Certificate of Incorporation; current CRS classification or AEOI registration evidence; an economic substance statement describing the offshore stock-media licensing business and absence of Vanuatu domestic-source activity; audited financial statements or a board-approved financial summary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of initial capital for foreign currency account funding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six-to-twelve month bank statements from the contributing shareholder or corporate parent; signed source-of-wealth declaration; purchase or sale contracts, previous dividend distributions, payroll statements, tax returns, or any documented disposal creating the funds; notarized authorization of the capital injection by the board of directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity digital payment activity through Stripe or PayPal
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed merchant services agreements; platform settlement metrics; line-by-line revenue model by territory; refund and chargeback policy; licensing contract samples; standard end-user license terms; customer due diligence procedures confirming the platform does not process prohibited industries; named AML compliance officer for the corporate group.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspicion of bearer share, nominee shareholding, or undisclosed beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory declaration that no bearer shares are outstanding; evidence of cancellation or physical immobilization of any legacy bearer instruments; share ledger showing each registered shareholder; disclosure of nominee relationships and an overriding declaration of the true natural-person UBO; consent from the registered agent verifying compliance with the Vanuatu International Companies Act.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial equity and shareholder loan funding should be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the investor's licensed bank directly to the International Company's USD settlement account at a Vanuatu authorized dealer. The remittance instruction must include a clear purpose code such as 'Direct investment in share capital' or 'Capital contribution to non-resident International Company', together with the full legal entity name and Vanuatu corporate registration number. The receiving bank will conduct a source-of-funds verification and may require the board resolution authorizing the share issuance, the executed share subscription agreement, and the stated consideration per share. No VUV conversion is mandatory because Vanuatu does not impose an exchange-control surrender regime and the inward funds may remain in the United States dollar treasury ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Stock-photo royalty disbursements, generative visual asset licensing fees, and creator payouts are intangibles trade and digital services. The standard clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 plain transfer from the Vanuatu USD treasury account to the recipient bank, using the remittance description 'Stock image licensing royalty' or 'Digital content license fee'. For retail creator payouts, the company should use Stripe Connect and PayPal MassPay rails to low-value disbursements, with automated reconciliation files and a daily or weekly SWIFT top-up from the Vanuatu settlement account. Commercial letters of credit are not a usual rail for digital content licensing and should be reserved for separately documented high-value content acquisitions with physical deliverables, invoice milestones, and inspection certificates.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore VUV/USD and VUV/AUD forward contracts executed by a Reserve Bank of Vanuatu authorized dealer for genuine commercial exposure arising from expected licensing receipts
Offshore non-deliverable VUV forwards settled in USD where the Vanuatu vatu leg remains synthetic and no illegal physical delivery of VUV outside the regulated onshore market occurs
USD-denominated cross-currency interest rate swaps or cross-currency basis swaps used to convert a fixed USD equity injection into VUV-denominated working capital under board-approved treasury policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VFSC International Company Government Fee (Annual Maintenance Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual on the anniversary of date of incorporation; grace period of 1 calendar month; renewed each calendar year thereafter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 25% of the unpaid annual fee is imposed if settlement is not made within one month after the anniversary date; continued non-payment for six months may result in administrative strike-off of the International Company by the VFSC Registrar.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Facility Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneous with the annual VFSC government fee anniversary date; agent renewal documentation is due on the same anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and registered agent is a statutory breach; the VFSC may refuse annual renewal, impose administrative penalties, and ultimately strike off the company from the International Companies Register.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit applies to a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act (Cap 222). Financial statements are not required to be filed with VFSC. An audited statement may only be required for commercial due diligence, institutional counterparty approval, or an optional license application, not as a statutory annual obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting framework is imposed by the International Companies Act. An International Company may maintain internal records on any recognized basis, including IFRS or a simplified cash-based records system, provided that the records sufficiently reflect the tax-exempt international status.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu International Companies are not subject to a public UBO filing or annual beneficial ownership confirmation to VFSC. However, the International Company must maintain an internal register of beneficial owners at the registered office, and the licensed registered agent must obtain current ownership data; any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be noted in the internal register and the updated ownership record retained by the agent. No outward annual UBO declaration is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required by statute; voluntary certified audit for fintech or institutional purposes typically ranges from USD 2,000 - USD 6,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax at the national level. An International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] is statutorily exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, dividend withholding tax, and stamp duty on worldwide income, irrespective of profit distribution.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax rate 0% for offshore stock-photo and generative-AI visual asset licensing income. No income tax, no turnover tax, no net-worth tax. Only fixed, profit-unrelated imposts apply: (1) VFSC annual government fee (approx. VUV 300–VUV 10,000 scaled by authorized share capital), (2) registered agent and registered office professional fees, and (3) a Vanuatu Business Licence fee only if a fixed local establishment is opened. VAT at 15% (Value Added Tax Act [CAP 141]) applies only to taxable supplies made in Vanuatu; offshore digital downloads invoiced to non-residents are out of scope or zero-rated. The VAT registration threshold is VUV 5,000,000 of Vanuatu taxable supplies per 12 months. Loss carryforward is legally irrelevant: the concept of a taxable loss does not exist for an exempt IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return (Form 6) under the International Companies Act [CAP 222]; filed electronically through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Compliance portal (www.vfsc.vu), submitted exclusively by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, aligned to the incorporation anniversary date, not calendar fiscal year-end.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 3 months after each anniversary of the date of incorporation. The annual government fee must accompany the filing; an extra 30-day grace period is not statutorily available.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered name and VFSC registration number as set out in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign beneficial owners ensure the legal name carries no Vanuatu domestic indicator (e.g., 'Limited' is acceptable; 'Vanuatu' brand suffix is optional). State the IC-issued registration number verbatim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Address of the registered office in Vanuatu, which must be the office of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs cannot maintain a standalone physical registered office without local premises; the agent's address is mandatory and must be kept current.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the Vanuatu-registered agent and the agent's compliance attestation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent confirms CDD/KYC on all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners; foreign principals must provide certified passports, proof of address, and source-of-funds declarations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationality, residential address, date of appointment, and date of cessation for each director and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; at least one individual with local agent authority must be designated for service of process. Dual-role director/shareholder disclosure is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, par or no-par value designation, issued and paid-up shares, share classes, and registered holders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Shares in an IC may be held 100% by non-residents; bearer shares, if issued, must be deposited with the registered agent; no minimum capital is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration that the IC has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, has not held or leased land in Vanuatu, and has not conducted banking, insurance, or trust business without a specific licence.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors must confirm that all stock-photo and AI-asset customer contracts are concluded with non-residents and that no services are rendered inside Vanuatu; false certification is a criminal offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC carries on a 'relevant activity' under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019: banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, finance and leasing, headquarters, holding company, IP business, or distribution and service centre.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A marketplace selling AI-generated visual assets to unrelated third-party end customers is not a relevant activity. If the IC licenses IP to or purchases services from affiliates, the relevant-activity box must be ticked and full ESR documentation filed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the register of beneficial owners is maintained at the registered agent's office and updated within 14 days of any change.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ultimate individual owners at or above 25% must be identified; trustees and nominee arrangements require layered disclosure to the agent; STR reporting obligations apply to the agent under the AML/CFT Act 2014.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a monthly late fee on the annual government fee; failure to file for two consecutive cycles triggers automatic strike-off and dissolution, with assets vesting in the Republic of Vanuatu (bona vacantia). Reinstatement requires a Supreme Court order plus payment of all arrears, penalties, and restoration costs. Continuing to trade after strike-off renders directors personally liable for debts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (Form VAT-1) filed through the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) e-Services portal; applicable only if the IC is registered for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 141] — registration is compulsory only when Vanuatu taxable supplies exceed VUV 5,000,000 in 12 months and is not typically triggered by offshore digital licensing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly (calendar quarters ending 31 March, 30 June, 30 September, 31 December).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the end of each calendar quarter, with payment of any net VAT due at the same time.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 15% output tax on Vanuatu taxable supplies and imports.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs report zero in Box 1 for offshore downloads and licence fees; cross-border supply of digital assets to non-residents is zero-rated or out of scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input tax credits on Vanuatu purchases bearing a valid VAT invoice.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC without a Vanuatu fixed establishment cannot reclaim local input VAT; recovery is limited to invoices addressed to a Vanuatu-registered branch.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Net VAT Payable or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between Box 1 and Box 2; payable to VRC or carried as refund claim.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export zero-rating shifts the box to a refund position only where valid input VAT was incurred; refunds are subject to VRC inspection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Listing of zero-rated and out-of-scope supplies, including offshore stock-photo licences and AI-generated asset downloads.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain geolocation evidence (IP logs, customer residency, payment-rail settlement country) to substantiate non-resident supply; Stripe and PayPal settlement reports are acceptable supporting documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Valid Business Licence number where the IC holds a Vanuatu fixed establishment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore-only ICs leave this box blank; obtaining a Vanuatu Business Licence without local substance may itself trigger ESR scrutiny.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: penalty of 25% of the VAT due; late payment: interest at 15% per annum plus recovery action; incorrect or false returns: fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and, for fraudulent evasion, imprisonment up to 2 years. VRC may also impose a 25% shortfall penalty on understated tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to any shareholder, resident or non-resident. Distributions may be paid in any freely convertible currency; no government approval, no capital duty, and no exchange control applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable on the Vanuatu side: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) in force. Its international tax network consists of Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand, Japan, and multiple OECD/EU states, plus membership of the OECD Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters. There is therefore no DTA withholding rate to invoke and no TRC relief application procedure in Vanuatu. Where the shareholder's residence jurisdiction grants foreign tax credit or asks for proof of the IC's status, the IC may obtain from VFSC a Certificate of Corporate Status / Tax Residency (fee approx. VUV 5,000) and a registered-agent certificate confirming the IC's tax-exempt classification.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% — no Vanuatu withholding tax on royalties or interest paid by an IC to non-resident licensors, technology providers, or lenders. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA). Practical caution: the payor-side jurisdiction of the IC's customers (e.g., U.S. 30% default or treaty-reduced U.S. withholding on royalty streams) may withhold at source, so licence and payment-rail contracts should clearly allocate gross-up or net-of-tax responsibility.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File / Master File threshold in VUV exists because Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax and has no Transfer Pricing Act. Under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, an IC carrying on a relevant activity involving related parties must nevertheless maintain contemporaneous accounting records demonstrating arm's length character, retain them for 7 years, and produce them to the Commissioner within 21 days of demand. If the IC belongs to a foreign group with consolidated revenue exceeding EUR 750 million, the ultimate parent's OECD Country-by-Country Report must include the Vanuatu entity. Practical threshold for a stock-photo/AI-asset IC: any related-party royalty, service fee, or distribution arrangement, regardless of amount, triggers documentation discipline.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 and associated Regulations apply to ICs conducting a 'relevant activity' (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, finance and leasing, headquarters, holding company, IP business, distribution and service centre). A commercial stock-photo and generative-AI visual asset marketplace selling to unrelated third-party end customers through Stripe and PayPal does not ordinarily constitute a relevant activity, because the 'distribution and service centre' head requires provision of goods or services to related parties. To retain non-relevance, the IC must ensure (i) all material contracts are with unrelated customers, (ii) the beneficial owner is not the sole licensee of the AI model, and (iii) any licensed-in IP from an affiliate is paid at arm's length royalty. If the self-assessment changes to 'relevant', the IC must demonstrate substantial core income-generating activities in Vanuatu: at least one board meeting in Vanuatu per year, a resident director, a company secretary, physical premises, local payroll, and adequate operating expenditure. Failure to file the ESR declaration or to satisfy the substance test is a criminal offence triable both against the company and its officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Offshore Tax Evasion / Foreign CFC Recharacterization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a zero-tax invoice mill while actual management, negotiation, contract execution, IP development, and strategic decisions occur in the beneficial owner's high-tax residence (e.g., U.S. or EU), with no arm's length payment for functions performed — leading foreign tax authorities to recharacterize the IC as a sham, apply CFC/controlled-foreign-company rules, or invoke GAAR.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In Vanuatu: no local tax charge arises, but VFSC may strike off the IC if it discovers domestic business activity or false declarations. In the shareholder's jurisdiction: reassessment of all digital-asset royalty income at the shareholder level (e.g., U.S. federal rate 21% plus state income tax), 20–40% accuracy-related penalties, statutory interest, criminal referral for willful evasion (up to 5 years' imprisonment in the U.S.), and equivalent EU/UK GAAR counteraction with double-tax elimination denied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors signing false non-resident declarations face personal fines up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 2 years under the International Companies Act. Foreign courts may impose civil restitution against the beneficial owner as shadow director, issue travel bans, and pierce the corporate veil to attach personal assets where the IC is a mere alter ego.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the IC as a pure shell — no resident director, no local meetings, no books in Vanuatu, no substance — while declaring 'no relevant activity' despite performing IP distribution, AI-asset licensing, or service-centre functions for a related party; or holding valuable copyrights and AI-model weights on behalf of a foreign parent without management and control in Vanuatu.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate penalty up to VUV 2,000,000 and daily default penalty up to VUV 100,000; mandatory referral by VFSC to the Financial Intelligence Unit and the OECD Global Forum; inclusion on the EU Annex II 'grey list' (Vanuatu was listed in October 2024) triggers enhanced due diligence by EU financial institutions and loss of EU withholding benefits and grant eligibility.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are personally liable for unpaid penalties; the Vanuatu Supreme Court may issue travel bans and asset-freezing orders; making a false ESR declaration is punishable by imprisonment up to 2 years; the veil is pierced where the corporation operates as the shareholder's instrumentality, exposing personal assets to civil restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting thousands of low-value micro-license payments through Stripe and PayPal without customer due diligence, without maintaining the beneficial ownership register at the registered agent, without an appointed AML compliance officer, and without filing suspicious transaction reports (STRs) with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; or using the IC to launder proceeds of copyright piracy, stolen training data, or payment-card fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fine up to VUV 1,000,000; suspension or revocation of the registered agent's licence and the IC's good standing; confiscation of proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act; aggravated money-laundering conviction carries a fine up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners face criminal prosecution, personal confiscation orders, freezing of foreign bank accounts, extradition under Vanuatu mutual assistance treaties, and travel bans; failure to file an STR is a standalone offence punishable by up to 2 years' imprisonment; compliance officers and directors are personally accountable for knowledge-based failures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the VFSC Form 6 Annual Return or pay the annual government fee for two consecutive years; failure to update the beneficial ownership register within 14 days of a change; failure to notify VFSC of a change of registered agent or directors within 21 days.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative strike-off and dissolution; all company assets, including the stock-photo IP portfolio and AI-model copyrights, vest in the Republic of Vanuatu as bona vacantia; the IC loses legal capacity to sue or enforce contracts while struck off; restoration is possible only by Supreme Court order with full arrears, penalties, and legal costs paid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who trade, transfer IP, or dissipate assets after strike-off are jointly and severally liable for the company's debts; foreign courts may impose travel bans pending resolution; distribution agreements and Stripe/PayPal merchant accounts terminate automatically on loss of good standing, causing irrecoverable revenue loss.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misuse of Tax-Exempt Status / Prohibited Domestic Business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Earning Vanuatu-source income — e.g., selling photography services to Vanuatu resorts, licensing images to Vanuatu media, employing local staff, owning or leasing Vanuatu land, or operating an unlicensed domestic payment business — while continuing to claim the offshore-exempt IC status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retroactive loss of the tax exemption: the IC becomes assessable to 15% VAT, Business Licence fees, PAYE on local employees, customs duties on imported equipment, and any future Vanuatu corporate tax; VFSC may order compulsory winding-up for breach of the non-resident business prohibition; administrative fines apply for each prohibited act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly authorize domestic business are personally liable for unpaid taxes, fees, and fines; the Court may disqualify directors for up to 5 years and issue civil restitution orders for profits derived from the prohibited activity; in egregious cases, the directors face criminal prosecution and imprisonment.
